{{Quote|I earned my scars at the Jedi Temple, shot a Jedi in the back. Proudest moment of my life so far.|Captain Westro|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Westro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Forty-second Imperial Infantry]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Sacking of Coruscant|Sacking]], Westro led a number of Imperial soldiers inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to attack the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] under [[Darth Malgus]]' command. He was able to shoot a Jedi in the back until he received a couple of scars during the firefight. Westro was considered to be the bravest Imperial.<ref name="TOR" />
